subject: Request for transitional endorsement memo to cover post-report window
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@brightaudit.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request — transitional endorsement memo for post-report period

Hi Rohan,

Quick note from BrightAudit. We have Helio Health in the queue for final review; their SOC 2 Type II report you provided covers the period ending 2026-07-31. Procurement has asked for confirmation of controls through the present date (we need to cover 2026-08-01 -> 2026-11-01).

Can Redwood provide a short Transitional Endorsement/Continuity memo (often called a bridge letter or management assertion) that: 1) confirms no material control changes since 2026-07-31 or lists changes with compensating controls, 2) attaches the SOC 2 report (we already have a copy, but please attach your authoritative PDF), and 3) indicates who will sign and the expected signing date.

If you can also include a control-change log and any KMS rotation summary for the period, that would speed Helio's procurement and our review. Ideally we would have the memo by EOD Friday 6 Nov to close the Helio review on time.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Senior Auditor, BrightAudit
sam.patel@brightaudit.com

---
Attachment: (none with this request)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request — transitional endorsement memo for post-report period

Looping you both in — BrightAudit (Sam) needs a short transitional endorsement/memo to bridge the gap between our SOC 2 report (period ended 2026-07-31) and today. Procurement at Helio is waiting on this to complete their vendor review.

What I need from you:
- Karthik: a one-page assurance note plus a control-change log/confirmations the auditor asked for.
- Irene: a quick legal signoff and routing for signature (we normally route to Marissa for sign-off).

I pulled the SOC 2 Type II PDF for reference and attached it here. Target: have a signed memo ready by 6 Nov so Sam can finalize Helio's review.

Thanks — Rohan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request — transitional endorsement memo for post-report period

Thanks — I can draft the Transitional Assurance Memorandum. Proposed contents (short):
- Statement: scope of original SOC 2 report and report end date (2026-07-31)
- Management assertion: status of controls since report end (notable changes or none)
- Summary of evidence provided: control change log, KMS rotation record, access-control snapshot (date-stamped)
- Signature line and routing instructions

Evidence I will attach: control_change_log_202607-1103.csv, kms_rotation_summary_202608-1104.csv (redacted), and an operational access snapshot as of 2026-11-01.

One legal note: if there are material control changes we should be explicit and reference compensating controls. If none, a short sentence is fine.

I'll have a first draft by Thu 05 Nov EOD so legal has time to review.

— Karthik
Director, Applied ML & Compliance (serving runtime team)

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -08:00

Karthik — that plan works. Two quick legal redlines to note for the draft:
1) Avoid absolute language around "no material changes" unless we can point to the control-change log and incident history (we can say "no material changes identified by management as of 2026-11-01").
2) Add a short statement about the authority to sign and contact for follow-ups.

I'll attach a one-page draft with suggested language and will route the final memo through DocuSign to Marissa for signature. Please include a placeholder for the DocuSign envelope id.

Irene
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
